title: Acceleration during thrust
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the acceleration during the pushing phase as 3 m/s².

title: Acceleration after thrust
description: Important: The student must identify the deceleration after release as 1 m/s² due to friction.

title: Kinematics for two phases
description: Important: The student must correctly set up the displacement equations for the acceleration and deceleration phases.

title: Success condition inequality
description: Essential: The student must establish the total displacement inequality: L1 - L2 ≤ x1 + x2 ≤ L1.

title: Solve for time range
description: Essential: The student must solve the inequality to find the final time condition: 1 s ≤ t ≤ (2√3)/3 s.

title: Sign error in net force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses F + μmg for net force during thrust.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (m, s, kg, N).
